description: Source code implementing a client-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication protocol, including functions for initializing a client, generating a public key, computing password verifier, deriving session key, verifying server response, and closing the client context.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client context with username, parameters, and salt after validating parameters.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public ephemeral value (A) for the SRP protocol.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes password verifier values (p and v) based on username, salt, and password.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key based on server's public value and client parameters.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies server response against expected hash.

methods.name: t_clientresponse
methods.description: Returns the computed session response hash.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the client context.
